'''Clan Askar''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]]. They originally discovered the [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel system]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]]. [[Rayl'skar]] was its clan leader.
